tool_input.prompt: Current stable TypeScript version, and any beta

tool_result_content:
**Current stable version: TypeScript 7.0.** The page says `npm install -g typescript` "will install the latest version (currently 7.0)," and links to "What's new in 7.0."

**Upcoming beta: TypeScript 7.1.** The page links to "What's upcoming in 7.1?", which points to an announcement of the 7.1 beta. The page doesn't give a beta version number or install tag, so check the [npm package page](https://www.npmjs.com/package/typescript) for the current beta tag.

To install the stable version in a project (the approach the page recommends):

```bash
npm install typescript --save-dev
npx tsc
```

To install it globally:

```bash
npm install -g typescript
```
